listener_lifetime.note: JsListener with id/event_type/capture/once/callback stored in BTreeMap

teardown_rules.note: listeners cleared on navigation via state reset

microtask_checkpoint.note: EvalCtx microtask queue with MAX_PROMISE_JOBS budget

custom_elements_define.note: validates hyphenated tag, logs to platform_operations

custom_elements_get_whenDefined.note: get returns Undefined, whenDefined returns resolved promise

mutation_observer.note: constructor allocates id, observe registers targets with options, disconnect clears, takeRecords drains queued MutationRecord objects

resize_observer.note: constructor allocates observer id, observe registers target

intersection_observer.note: constructor allocates observer id, observe registers target, takeRecords returns empty array

slot_flattening.note: Bounded profile does not implement nested slot flattening

dom_traversal.note: parent/child/sibling navigation via node tree; NodeIterator/TreeWalker/Range deferred

form_controls.note: FormData get/has/append/delete, form submit with validation

focus_click.note: focus/click dispatch events with default actions

css_layout.note: selector matching and basic layout; flex/grid placement partial

readable_stream.note: constructor returns JsvObject with locked property, getReader returns reader with closed promise, cancel returns resolved promise, tee returns two stream objects

cors_policy.note: origin policy enforced at network layer; preflight caching deferred

gaps_deferred_to_frozen_profile: Full slot flattening and manual slot assignment
Full ReadableStream backpressure and chunked decoding
